reason: My customers already see my offers on WhatsApp broadcasts and groups for free, and this month's money already went on boosted Facebook posts. LKR 560 is small, but I don't see why I'd pay to send a text when WhatsApp already reaches them and they reply to me there.
objection: Why pay per SMS when my WhatsApp broadcast is free and my buyers already chat with me there? An SMS saying 'reply on WhatsApp' just sends them back to where I already am.
would_change_my_mind: Proof that SMS gets people to open and buy who ignore my WhatsApp broadcasts, like a seller like me getting more 12.12 orders from SMS than from WhatsApp.
